name: Bollard light
description: A black aluminum bollard with a warm light band under its cap, lining the research park's paths and bridges.
notes: Prepared with tools/prep_prop.py --height 1.0 --glow 0.75: 3,834 triangles, not decimated; 0.3 m base plate. The light band and the red dot glow (emission strength 4). Smart topology chosen over Meshy 7 by Bryson, 2026-10-11.
